product_one_liner.value: SnapLogic provides an enterprise platform that connects and orchestrates applications, data, APIs, and AI agents across cloud, on-premises, and hybrid environments.
product_one_liner.notes: SnapLogic describes its enterprise platform as securely connecting applications, data, APIs, and AI agents across cloud, on-premises, and hybrid environments: https://jobs.lever.co/snaplogic/3d408fe5-5fbb-4402-9c36-54a2bf2b9b59

pricing_page.notes: The public pricing page describes Essential, Professional, and Enterprise One packages: https://www.snaplogic.com/pricing

named_customers.notes: named_customers: Adobe and Aramark appear as customer logos on SnapLogic's pricing page, linked to its customer section: https://www.snaplogic.com/pricing | named_customers.0: Adobe is displayed as a customer logo on the pricing page. | named_customers.1: Aramark is displayed as a customer logo on the pricing page.

employee_band.notes: The company profile explicitly reports 201-500 employees. This is a third-party estimate: https://www.zoominfo.com/c/snaplogic-inc/262291773

hq_location.notes: hq_city: SnapLogic's company overview explicitly states that it is headquartered in San Mateo, California: https://www.snaplogic.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/SnapLogic-Company-Overview-2026.pdf | hq_country: The company overview identifies the headquarters as San Mateo, California; the company profile explicitly identifies the country as United States. Sources: https://www.snaplogic.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/SnapLogic-Company-Overview-2026.pdf and https://www.crunchbase.com/organization/snaplogic

founded_year.notes: The company overview explicitly states that SnapLogic was founded in 2006: https://www.snaplogic.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/SnapLogic-Company-Overview-2026.pdf

eng_blog.notes: Two qualifying posts describe internal engineering: E-Pods development infrastructure by former staff engineer Nilay Narlawar, and SnapLogic's scalable analytics architecture by engineer Indrajeet Kane. Sources: https://www.snaplogic.com/blog/epods-production-clones-for-developers, https://www.snaplogic.com/blog/scalable-analytics-platform-data-engineering-journey, https://www.snaplogic.com/blog/category/technical, and https://linkedin.com/in/indrajeetkane

public_docs.notes: The public documentation index links to multiple documentation areas, including AgentCreator, API Management, and public APIs: https://docs.snaplogic.com/

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: A live company posting seeks an Applied AI Architect and provides an application link. The fractional contract position qualifies by its AI title: https://jobs.lever.co/snaplogic/3d408fe5-5fbb-4402-9c36-54a2bf2b9b59

model_provider.notes: SnapLogic publicly announces that Anthropic's Claude is available in SnapGPT through Amazon Bedrock: https://www.snaplogic.com/company/newsroom/press-releases/amazon-bedrock-anthropic-claude-available-in-snapgpt

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: SnapLogic explicitly claims SOC 2 Type 2 and HIPAA-HITECH certification and GDPR compliance. ISO 27001 is mentioned only as an AWS capability, not SnapLogic's own certification, so it is excluded: https://www.snaplogic.com/products/security-compliance | compliance_certs.0: The security page explicitly names SOC 2 Type 2 among SnapLogic's certifications. | compliance_certs.1: The security page explicitly names HIPAA-HITECH. | compliance_certs.2: The security page explicitly claims GDPR compliance.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: PitchBook labels the most recent dated financing entry 'Debt - General'. This is later than the publicly announced 2021 equity round: https://pitchbook.com/profiles/company/51376-87 | funding_date: The latest dated company-financing entry found is completed debt financing on August 13, 2025, normalized to 2025-08. An undated secondary transaction is not treated as company fundraising: https://pitchbook.com/profiles/company/51376-87 | funding_amount_usd: PitchBook's August 13, 2025 completed debt-financing entry leaves the amount blank. The amount is therefore unknown; the $165 million from 2021 is not assigned to this later transaction: https://pitchbook.com/profiles/company/51376-87

raised_18mo.notes: PitchBook records completed debt financing on August 13, 2025, inside May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026. This supports a positive answer, but a public financing announcement or filing was not located; the evidence is a dated deal record: https://pitchbook.com/profiles/company/51376-87

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The live Sales Development Representative EMEA posting is a full-time sales-development role with an application link: https://jobs.lever.co/snaplogic/1728258e-f2e2-4913-93b0-e77077ab3f8b

launched_6mo.notes: On October 20, 2026, SnapLogic announced new platform capabilities for building AI agents and connecting them to enterprise systems and data, within the requested six-month window: https://www.snaplogic.com/company/newsroom/press-releases/snaplogic-expands-agentic-integration-platform-ai-agents

leadership_change_12mo.notes: A dated executive-change notice posted September 22, 2026 reports that CFO Ahsan Malik left SnapLogic, within the requested twelve-month window. The notice is third-party and does not specify the precise departure date: https://www.theofficialboard.com/news/snaplogic-2
